response.overview: The story follows Summayah (Farah Nabilah), a strong-willed woman who builds a family with Imran (Shahz Jaszle), an orphaned young man who is determined to prove his love. However, the newfound happiness they enjoy is destroyed when Imran is reported missing and believed to have died in a boat tragedy while on a preaching mission in Batam. Losing her husband while heavily pregnant becomes a dark chapter in Summayah's life. After giving birth to their son, Qhalifah Dhany (Sayf Mikael), she experiences severe emotional stress and depression that requires help to recover. To regain her strength and emotional stability, Summayah is sent to the Baiti Syifa therapy center. There she meets Luth Mikael (Razzuan Rosli), a therapist with his own unique charisma. Luth's presence gradually becomes Summayah's emotional support. Their relationship then develops into a new bond, opening a new chapter in Summayah's life. However, can this relationship heal the deep wounds she carries?
response.title: Sepenuh Hati Rindu
